from: arnav-claude: SPARSE route for nav:=mppi on courses/start-2026-11-07-tape (Chelsea's tape map). Anchors only where the course forces them; MPPI plans the line between them and around anything depth sees. Every straight leg >= 0.40 m from walls+nets on the tape map at 0.7 m (drone radius 0.29). Two chicane anchors keep the line on the NORTH side of the boulder at (0.8,-2.35): with one leg (0.37 m) MPPI sometimes went round its south side towards the south net, which depth cannot see. Map anchors: CP2 centre (-1.098,2.153) +-0.45 m on its normal (0.876,0.482); tunnel x 2.25-2.31; window centre (-0.471,-2.272) +-0.5 m on its normal (-0.940,0.343); pad (-2.042,-0.792).
